benchmarks.name: GraphInstruct — Quality Stotal (zero-shot)
benchmarks.description: Aggregate Quality Stotal under homogeneous zero-shot prompting. Weighted sum of per-level mean Quality across L0-L5 with weights (0.05, 0.10, 0.15, 0.20, 0.25, 0.25). Each level scored on five complementary dimensions (validity, structural correctness, attribute consistency, semantic fidelity, edit-distance accuracy); active subset varies by level. Averaged over 5 generations per instruction. Primary capability headline.

benchmarks.name: GraphInstruct L2 — Multi-Constraint Composition (zero-shot)
benchmarks.description: Per-level Quality at L2: simultaneous satisfaction of 4+ structural constraints under zero-shot prompting. L2 produces the largest T1-T3 tier gap (0.219), 3x the next-widest reasoning-heavy gap. Localizes benchmark discriminative power at compositional constraint satisfaction rather than reasoning depth.
